_comment: Gold-set labelers (DECISIONS D4, decided 2026-09-08 by Vincent Chan: Gabe Murphy and Reid as the two strategists, Vincent Chan adjudicating). Each slot is an email or auth user id matched against `profiles`. The adjudicator resolves on its own; `a` and `b` are deliberately left null because setting EITHER switches assignSlots to `configured` mode for BOTH (labels.ts: `configured = Boolean(config.a || config.b)`), and Reid has no `profiles` row yet — naming Gabe alone would leave Reid with no slot at all. While both are null the page assigns them by order of first label, with the adjudicator's own rows excluded, so Gabe takes `a` and Reid takes `b` on their first save. Name them here once Reid has an account, to remove the risk of a third admin taking a slot by labelling first; the import script needs --labeler-a / --labeler-b either way. This file and goldset-v1.manifest.json are imported at build time: editing either needs a rebuild and a redeploy to reach the page.
